name: Two Strangers
source:
The world ended 300 years ago.

Ravenous monsters who abhor life have destoyed it, and turned the world into a barren desert stretching out as far as the eye can see.

Kent's job is to destroy these monsters and protect the city of Muse, a scientifically advanced society that has managed to keep itself relatively safe in the centuries since the end of the old world.

One day while out on patrol, he tries to take on more then he can handle. Dying alone, he is saved by a stranger who takes him to an isolated house to rest and heal.

Spend the day seeing Kent and his savior, Daren, bond and learn about one another. Spend the night in Kent's memories as he recalls how he ended up in this situation, and other memories from his past.

[From [url=https://knowit01.itch.io/two-strangers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
300年前世界末日了。

憎恶生命的贪婪怪物摧毁了生命，将世界变成了一望无际的贫瘠沙漠。

肯特的工作是消灭这些怪物并保护缪斯市，这是一个科学先进的社会，自旧世界末日以来的几个世纪以来一直设法保持相对安全。

有一天，在外出巡逻时，他试图承担超出他能力范围的任务。他孤独地死去，一个陌生人救了他，把他带到一所偏僻的房子里休息和疗伤。

花一天时间拜访肯特和他的救世主达伦，加深感情并了解彼此。在肯特的回忆中度过一夜，他回想起自己是如何陷入这种境地的，以及他过去的其他记忆。

[来自[url=https://knowit01.itch.io/two-strangers]Itch.io[/url]]
